notes.content:
Beloved railroad engineers,

during the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2211170/Unrailed_2_Back_on_Track]Unrailed 2[/url] announcement yesterday , we also pushed a new update for Unrailed!, introducing Jeff the Giraffe and some fixes and improvements!

- New: Added Jeff as playable character who is introducing also U2
- New: Allow fast skipping in replays (in ESC menu)
- New: Allow players to hide Session ID in Lobby (in ESC menu)
- New: Allow hosts to prevent joining during normal gameplay (Always|Only in Shop,Lobby|Only in Lobby)
- New: Added a respawn button for the bot in Singleplayer. Either mappable to an input (e.g. keyboard) or via the escape menu

- New: You can add replayfps [fps] to you setting file to improve replay quality. Note that this will prevent you from uploading you replays to the highscore!
- Improvement: High ping warning in ping bubble
- Improvement: Compass wagon displays next map in shop (only if host version is recent enough)
- Improvement: Light Wagon Flicker when running out of fuel
- Improvement: Controller additional Dead-Zone slider implemented.
- Improvement: Respawned tools are now placed directly underneath the train if possible
- Improvement: Reworked the timings for the emoji menu. It should now be easier to select emojis using directional inputs (e.g. WASD/Thumbstick)
- Fix: Reworked tool respawning code to hopefully prevent most if not almost all cases of missing tools. If game cannot directly respawn missing tool it will try again
- Fix: Game freeze when trying to place the tracks around the train station in a spiral.
- Fix: Not assigning any movement sticks when failing to parse gamepad file
- Fix: Crashing when not having a valid online state
- Fix: Reloading old broken gamepad file on every launch (Needs testing)
- Fix: Possible workaround for cases where tracks on bridges can't be placed (Needs testing)

notes.title: Kick & Ban Update
notes.content:
Dear track building community,

we recently pushed pushed some changes around the kick/ban system but we noticed some bugs as well as occasional accidental blockings of friends. Therefore we tried to overhaul it a bit. Here is an overview:

- You can kick via [ESC]->[Manage Players]

- The host kicks instantly. Non-master players can majority vote-kick. Kicked players will be thrown out of a session.

- When kicking, you'll be asked whether you want to block the player as well. If you are host and blocked a player, the player won't be able to join any your sessions anymore (that is why you don't want to block your friends). You can unblock players in the main menu under [ESC]->[Blocked Players]. 

- Additionally, we have now the possibility to issue global blocks ("[b]bans[/b]"). Banned players will automatically be blocked from every session if the host did not un-block the player via the block list locally. That means if you're banned, you can still play with your friends online if you ask them to un-block you. However, random matchmaking will be disabled.
[strike]We want to ban players who actively try to sabotage other matches. We decide on evidence (eg replays) from Discord and we count all (locally) issued blocks as well. In any case, if you're banned, feel free to reach out to us[/strike]
UPDATE: The comments showed that the previous phrasing was very unclear. We only issue bans if we hear from many many players complains about someone actively griefing and have enough evidence to verify that. Bans are manually issued by us. They are NOT issued automatically and NOT issued pre-emptively. Bans are also not forever, we can easily unban if you reach out to us. In fact, we'd love to see everyone rehabilitated! Bans can be considered as are last resort for extreme cases to protect the community. It's a feature that has been wished many times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859694/081b4608e8a1fbe6ad7d0c90ef6f315fc9aeae5e.png[/img]

We are going to ban some players right away and hope that less players are motivated to grief in general.

Thank you for your support and happy trackbuilding! <3


Changelog:
- New: You'll be notified when you're banned
- Improvement: Kicked players no longer get added to block list automatically. Instead, a popup appears to ask whether you want to block the player as well.
- Improvement: The block list now indicates which blocks are global blocks
- Fix: Player flickering when in block list
- Fix: Lost achievement reachable in shop
- Fix: (Hopefully) Controller remapping can no longer unbind movement stick
- Fix: Invite friends option reappeared in lobby
- Fix: Crash dumper sometimes having issues
- Neat: You can add replayfps [fps] to you setting file to improve replay quality. Note that this will prevent you from uploading you replays to the highscore!

Oh and completely unrelated: Did you know that you can change the camera in the replays since our very old versions? We added a small documentation here: https://unrailed-wiki.com/page/Replay

notes.title: Experimental Version Update
notes.content:
Beloved railroad engineers,

on the [b]experimental[/b] branch, we pushed some fixes around the kick/ban feature. Some of you accidentally banned friends and sometimes the block did not correctly work.

The idea is the following:
- You can kick as before but kicked players can join again if they want.
- When kicking, you'll be asked whether you want to block the player as well. If the host blocked the player, the player will never be able to join any session of the host again. You can unblock in the main menu under "Blocked Players".
- Additionally, we can issue global blocks ("bans"). Banned players will be automatically blocked from every session if the host did not un-ban the player via the block list locally.

notes.title: The Underwater Update Is Here!
notes.content:
Heya railroad workers!

It has been a while since the last major update, so we're stoked this update is finally out of the door. This time, we're heading for the depths of the oceans! You will have to defy the challenge of the deep to return back to the surface. We've also updated and improved our most beloved compass-wagon, added crossplay to the time-mode and more (see the changelog below).

Here's a more visual look at what's new:

[previewyoutube=kFKZj158r1g;full][/previewyoutube]

Or alternatively at a glance:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859694/eb303f263c9ee05b50c01d55128a19430afe9685.png[/img]

Since the TIME mode goes out of beta with this update, we decided to wipe the highscores for it.
Now is the perfect time to submit your new scores!

Have any question about the update? Ask us here or on our [url=https://discord.gg/unrailed]Discord server[/url].

- New: Underwater biome added
- New: Time mode now cross-play compatible (Meaning that console versions got updated to the same version)
- New: Former compass wagon acts now as map wagon
- New: Special themed main menu
- New: Separate ambient sound setting in settings
- New: Default character selection in settings
- Crash fix: Game sometimes not starting on Windows 7
- Improvement: Savegame menu opens fater
- Improvement: Internally we support now up to 8 connected controllers such that 4 external controllers on steam deck should work now
- Improvement: The highscore ui now shows if replay is available
- Improvement: Uploading highscore UI in replay more responsive
- Improvement: Added new certificate to the linux/mac version of mono hopefully reducing faults
- Improvement: Allow for further distances in sandbox
- Fix: Atmosphere not correctly played in main menu
- Fix: Milk wagon plunger offset fixed
- Fix: Meteor not correctly saved in save files
- Fix: Extreme CPU on one thread CPUs
- Fix: Use less then N tracks was impossible in some cases
- Fix: Some Buttons did not make any sound in menu
- Fix: Rare race condition made mapgen crash on first extreme map
- Fix: Some game end screens assumed that player used checkpoints when they didn't
- Fix: Music fixes in main menu
- Fix: "No space for improvement" did trigger at wrong occasions 
- Fix: Controller remapping sometimes lost
- Fix: Bot did not behave correctly with the buckinator wagon

notes.title: Steam Deck Support & the Return of Halloween-Mode!
notes.content:
Heya railroad workers!

Halloween is around the corner and our decorated main menu, as well as our "Spooky" halloween-mode will return 🎃!

Aaaand in other news, Unrailed is now officially Steam Deck verified!

Combining both together, this is what you could look like:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859694/b99cf9b8591dcf8cba671750004cff7e8c974a92.png[/img]

Happy Deck-o-ween!



Changelog 2.0-405ad9df7:
- Improvement: Spooky-Mode now available in local or (online) Time-Lobby and the menu is halloween themed
- Improvement: General performance improvements (shader improvements, map-gen is more efficient, lag-spikes should be reduced). Especially for low-end devices should profit.
- Improvement: Many sound bug fixes and improvements (thanks to @MtildeMusic & @felixbarbarino for going through all the sounds again)
- Improvement: Signed executable to lower false positive virus alerts (Windows only)
- Improvement: Game adapts to the Steam Deck: Higher UI font-size and hides keyboard UI elements until a keyboard button is pressed
- Improvement: Old crashdumps are automatically removed on startup
- Improvement: experimental-fna3 updated to FNA version 22.0.7 (containing all their bug fixes and improvements, especially related to D3D11, Vulkan support and much more, also containing a newer SDL version)
- Improvement: Added VC++ 2013 redistributable to mitigate startup errors when not having it installed (Windows only)
- Crash fix: "Yeti-Bug". Killing Yetis and Snowmen could lead to crashes (when new and old versions were playing together (eg PC & Console cross-plays))
- Crash fix: Crashes related to the Highscore menu
- Bug Fix: Negative time in Time Mode was not synced and not visible in the replay
- Change: Bot now suggests to join our Discord after pressing "Start Game" 
- Change: Non-modifiable controls in the "manage controller" menu are shown at the bottom (eg menu controls)
- Change: MacOS & Linux builds updated to FNA 22.0.7 (for windows, use the experimental-fna3d branch)

Heya Railroad-Engineers!

If you have read our last announcement what follows should sound pretty familiar. First off, the owl sitting smugly in the tree above joins the character roster (you'll have to unlock it though). Furthermore, there are a couple of performance improvements, bug fixes and some balancing changes. We also threw some new achievements into the mix:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859694/f5ec9a76af120df5576adadf975bd528f8d092fa.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Players can now reorder wagons in the shop
[*] There's now a third page of emoji to alert the team to the current quest or to signal AFK-time
[*] A small notification will pop up when new characters are unlocked
[*] Many improvements that make the single-player bot smarter
[/list]
As announced, this is the update that breaks current savegames and replays but is hopefully the last one to do so. If that is new to you, no need to panic - you can still access them by switching to a legacy version of Unrailed (right-click on the game, choose [i]Properties...[/i], then [i]BETAS[/i] and choose [i]legacy-0.10-c2379ab4c[/i] from the dropdown list). Similarly, you can access old highscores by selecting [i]legacy[/I] at [url=https://unrailed-online.com/highscore]unrailed-online.com/highscore[/url]

Finally, there will be a demo availabe in the next couple of days. In case you aren't sure what to expect from Unrailed, you can now easily find out! Just note that the demo only shows a small subset of the game - there is a lot more to discover and unlock in the full version.

As always, should you run into any issues with this update, or have an idea what we can improve let us know below or on our [url=https://discord.gg/unrailed]Discord server[/url].

notes.title: Pre-Release Preparation Update
notes.content:
Heya Railroad-Engineers!

We would like to give you the most important details for the next update.

The main reason for the next update (scheduled for the 17th of August at 7pm CEST) is pushing the technical base for the full-release-update for the game. The next update is neither the Early Access release, nor the final update. The release will be at some point soon but we can't give any specific information on that yet, except that we are also working on the Switch, PS4 and Xbox One port, which are planned to be released together, if possible.

The upcoming update is only a small subset of the new features we are planning for the Early Access release. The update will consist mostly of performance improvements, bug fixes, balancing updates, some new achievements, overall polishing, as well as a new owl character as mentioned before.

Due to the balancing and the technical changes we made, the new version will unfortunately be incompatible with existing savegames and replays and the highscore table will be branched off (meaning the old highscores will still be visible online but not ingame anymore). We are really sorry for that :( - we tried to keep compatability for as long as we could but it finally became infeasible to keep migrating all the old data. We will keep the current version on a separate branch on steam  ("legacy-0.10-c2379ab4c" which can be accessed in the BETAS tab in the game properties in steam), so that if you wish to play the old version, you can still do so. Note that the update does not affect your in-game progress.

Above that, as mentioned previously, our publisher plans to adjust the price with this update due to the upcoming ending of the Early Access phase and we will provide a Demo version.

At this point we want to mention how happy we are about all players who joined our community and kept us motivated on working on the game and who helped us shaping and finding new ideas as well as bugs. Thanks to you, we made it thus already into the 11th month of our originally 6 month planned Early Access time. Also, since many players don't know us from the beginning, we want to make a small summary of what has changed in the game during that time:
[list]
[*] Savegames & Checkpoints
[*] Additional wagons & characters & emojis & ping tool
[*] Sandbox mode
[*] Single-player mode
[*] Achievements
[*] Online reconnecting & ability to join into running sessions, kicking, etc
[*] Online highscores with replays
[*] Accessibility options, widescreen support, new languages, etc
[*] Linux & macOS versions
[*] Balancing & Bug fixes & technical improvements
[*] And more to come soon :)
[/list]

Thank you all,
Indoor Astronaut & Daedalic Entertainment

notes.title: The Single-Player Update
notes.content:
[b]Heya railroad workers![/b]

This update has been in the works for a loooong time. A single player mode was actually one of the first things we worked on after we bolted down the core gameplay.  We iterated through a couple of design approaches, however we never felt that the single-player mode came close enough to the chaotic gameplay that ensues when playing Unrailed cooperatively. 

But since a single-player mode has been by far the most requested feature since our launch in September, we decided to really focus on that mode and thought a lot about how to make it as interactive and chaotic as Unrailed is when played with other players. And we think this time we managed to get there.

What we came up with is the following: When you play alone, the bot will help you out! And just like with human players, you can give it commands using emoji, but the bot will actually follow them😁. You can even let it know exactly where you want to lay your tracks through and the bot helps you plough through that path.

Also, we added a sandbox-mode, where you can customize your train right at the beginning with all things you have already unlocked, to help you train with different train-setups.

We hope you'll dig the new modes as much as we do! 

And as always, should you have any feedback, leave it down here or on our [url=https://discord.gg/unrailed]Discord-server[/url].

notes.title: 2nd Early Access Update
notes.content:
Heya railroad workers!

Alright, time for update number two. It's a smaller one but it comes with two frequently requested featuers - new languages and savegames:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859694/182e2af6680b387556b99e972786c2ffcfe3087b.png[/img]

Languages are pretty self-explanatory (and featured in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/34859694/announcements/detail/1725372378527998693]another post[/url]), but let me say a couple of words about savegames: We know they are a controversial feature because on one hand, they allow inexperienced players to progress faster, but on the other hand it might take away from the roguelike core of Unrailed.

We decided to tackle this problem in two parts:
Part one allows you save [b]and quit[/b] at each train station and continue if you return - but there is still permadeath - if you crash you have to begin from scratch.  This is just a convenience feature for people that want to split their sessions into parts.
Part two enables players to progress in the game without having to restart from the beginning if they crash. Here the first station in each new biome acts as a checkpoint. This means you'll still have to work quite a bit for each checkpoint, but allows you to learn quicker from your mistakes. However, games with checkpoints activated are not shown on the online leaderboards.

As always, if you have feedback or even already an idea how we could improve our save-system-approach come by our [url=https://discord.gg/73HFDQj]Discord server[/url].

Our wee little track-building game is now already about a month and a half old! It was a blast to see the community grow this fast and wholesome. Our Discord has reached 2'500 members and Unrailed has been watched on Twitch alone for over 600'000 hours. Even from a competitive standpoint new heights were reached: The previous record featured in our last post has since been beaten by one of nearly double the distance!

Since launch we've wached on all these channels for feedback and new content ideas. And we distilled parts of that into our first update. Check a look at the follwing graphic to see what we added and improved:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859694/8ccd6359c3bfe390b4207418b1479e15bb96c226.png[/img]

notes.title: OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859694/19774a16ddde3ae12c8e950d3c2de5e65e4e2bda.png[/img]


[b]We are delighted to announce that the colourful co-op railway-building game Unrailed! is out now in Steam Early Access![/b]

[previewyoutube=QXmTZkgpFio;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]Check out our early access trailer!
Unrailed! demands strategy, coordination and communication across a variety of gameplay modes because this train simply will not stop for anything! Plan ahead, cut down trees and rocks, lay down tracks to avoid hazards, upgrade your train with new wagons, and fend off any creature that gets in your way. Play with up to four players in co-op, take on Endless mode, where just one misstep can end your journey, or work as a duo to get your train to the station before your rivals in competitive multiplayer.

As an extra bonus, all players who helped test Unrailed! during closed beta will be upgraded to the full version of the game for free as thanks from us to you. Your feedback provided in closed beta was invaluable to the game’s development, and we will definitely continue to work with the community on new features, improvements, fixes and more throughout early access. 
Keep up the great support!

[u][b]Key Features:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Unstoppable train action: Procedurally generated worlds offering immense replay value.
[*] Discover loads of landscapes, inhabitants, quests and crafting elements.
[*] Endless mode: Unlimited challenges with a mix of difficulty settings and wagon upgrades.
[*] Co-op multiplayer: Play online or locally with co-op for up to four players.
[*] Competitive multiplayer: Lay tracks in teams of two against real human opponents — who will get their train to the station first?
[/list]


If you want to get in contact with our Developers or more Unrailed-Fans, feel free to visit our [url=https://discord.gg/AJUFsZa]Discord Server[/url] - see you on the tracks!
